title: A Study of Orforglipron (LY3502970) on Cardiovascular Outcomes in Adults With Atherosclerotic Cardiovascular Disease and/or Chronic Kidney Disease (ATTAIN-Outcomes)
official: J2A-MC-GZPW: A Phase 3, Randomized, Double-Blind, Placebo-Controlled, Event-Driven Study to Investigate the Effect of Orforglipron on the Incidence of Major Adverse Cardiovascular Events in Participants With Established Atherosclerotic Cardiovascular Disease and/or Chronic Kidney Disease
summary: Main objective: To demonstrate whether orforglipron is superior to placebo in reducing the risk for major CV events.
criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Have heart disease, kidney disease, or both
Exclusion criteria:
1. Have type 1 diabetes
2. Have had a serious heart condition within 60 days of screening
3. Have New York Heart Association Functional Classification Class IV heart failure
